shortStoryLengthGuidance: Short stories are typically about 1,000–30,000 Chinese characters. You can also write flash fiction directly.
novellaLengthGuidance: Novellas are typically about 30,000–150,000 Chinese characters. Dividing them into volumes is optional.
decideLengthLater: You can decide the length later.
characterCountReferenceNotice: Character counts are for reference only. Exceeding them will not prevent you from writing.
conceptAndStructureSavedNotice: Concept and structure saved; this is not story State.
saveEditsBeforeSendingControlledContext: Save or cancel edits on this page before sending controlled context.
noManuscriptTextAvailable: No manuscript text available to select
readOnlyTaskStartedNotice: Read-only task started. Suggestions will not automatically change the manuscript or State.
saveConceptOrChapterPlanFirst: Save the concept card or chapter plan first.
saveWorkConfigurationConfirmation: Save the work configuration? If you switch modes, a full backup will be created first. The manuscript, volume outlines, stable IDs, Canon, and State will be preserved; you will handle structural differences.
chapterPlanSavedNotOccurredNotice: Chapter plan saved; this does not mean the events have occurred.
optionalFieldsAndAuthorWritingNotice: · All fields may be left blank. You write the manuscript; AI only provides candidates and diagnostics.
collectionOriginalWorkReferenceHelp: References the original short story; clicking Edit opens the original work. The name, description, and cover use the work details and cover editor.
collectionOrderSaved: Collection order saved. The original text was not copied.
structureReferenceFlexibilityHelp: The reference only provides questions. Stories may have no traditional conflict, twists, or character growth, and may have open endings.
structurePlanningStateHelp: You may leave fields blank and change their order. Plans will not be committed to State.
templateItemsPerLineHelp: One item per line; items can be deleted
templateSavedStoryCardPending: Template saved; the work's story concept card still needs to be saved.
copyPreviousWorkTemplateConfiguration: Copy template configuration from a previous work
copyTemplateConfigurationSource: Copy template configuration from a previous work
templateQuestionsOnlyCopied: Only template questions were copied. Text, settings, and secrets were not copied.
shortStoryNovellaPlanningHelp: Short stories may use continuous text. Novellas do not require volumes and use the existing Chapter Card and confirmation process.
plannedDetailsCharacterStateHelp: Scenes, foreshadowing, and expected knowledge are all plans. They will not be used to update character states.
noTextOrStateWriteSuffix: . No text or State will be written.
chapterPlanConfirmedTextEmpty: Chapter plan confirmed. The text is still empty.
optionalStateValidationToolsHelp: Enable the existing state diff and validation tools only when you need them. Plans, suspicions, and AI diagnoses will not automatically be committed as facts.
openStateKnowledgeConfirmationTools: Open existing State / Knowledge confirmation tools
installedSkillsTaskReportsHelp: Uses installed Skills and runs only the task you select each time. Reports are reference material for the author and are not sent to Writer verbatim.
selectedReadingScopeHelp: Selected reading scope (full text by default; reviews that exceed the budget will not be presented as full-text reviews)
analyzeFirstSelectedTextExcerpt: Analyze only an excerpt from the first selected text (for very long individual works)
excerptCharacterPositionHelp: Character positions use the editor's UTF-16 count. Excerpt reports will not be described as full-text reviews.
simulatedReaderEndorsementNotice: AI-simulated readers; no independent endorsement from real people
noAutomaticTextChangesSuffix: · Does not automatically modify the text
confirmSuggestionIntoEditBuffer: This field already contains author-written content. Add the selected suggestion to the edit buffer? You can cancel before saving.
candidateAddedToEditBuffer: Candidate added to the edit buffer; it takes effect only after you save the story concept card.
allowProactiveSuggestionControls: Allow proactive suggestion controls to appear (does not automatically write or commit facts)
dataBackupRestorePreviousMode: Data and backups · Restore previous mode
fullBackupRetainedSuffix: · A full backup has been retained.
writeWithoutSceneCardsHelp: You can write the text directly without scene cards.
separateNovelDataNotice: Each novel keeps separate world rules, characters, outlines, Canon and State.
firstIdeaCreationNotice: Start with an idea and develop it gradually. A project is created only after confirmation.
discardDraftSuffix: ” will be removed. Existing novels are not affected.
acceptCurrentProposalFirst: Accept the current proposal, with edits if needed, before continuing.
saveReturnNovels: Save and return to my novels
userLockedFacts: USER LOCKED · Facts that must not change
emptyMeansUnlocked: Leave blank to keep unlocked. Entered facts are explicitly locked.
uncertainMacroStructureHelp: You may enter “uncertain” or a range. This stage designs only the overall structure.
developExistingIdeaNotice: Develop conflict, characters and structure from your ideas. Every addition is a proposal awaiting confirmation.
aiRefineIdea: Ask AI to refine my idea
scopedRedoNotice: Redo one section · Keep other sections unchanged
ordinaryProtagonistExample: I would like a more ordinary protagonist, without exceptional genius.
aiRedoSection: Ask AI to redo a section
blankFoundationNotice: No AI proposal was adopted. Only empty templates and author input are initialized.
initialCanonStateNotice: Canon: user-locked facts are HARD; accepted AI foundations are STRONG. State starts empty.
worldOutlineNoProse: Prose not started · World building / Outline stage
